slice_preflight.method: Exact triangle-plane intersection + Shapely closed polygons, odd-even rings; not actual extrusion toolpaths

overhang_preflight.criterion: down-facing triangles >45 degrees from vertical, excluding build-plate bottom

limitations: Numerical mesh/slice checks do not guarantee adhesion, strength or support-free printing.
Use supports under the long curved gallery, tower lantern lintels, central lantern cap and overhangs; tune orientation, support removal and material.
Color-only window and trim boundaries are actual face assignments, not holes. Fine features may require enlargement or resin; lantern posts are model-thickened.
Solid massing model; no interior halls, basement, site grading, structural simulation or exact real-world scale.
